title: マチカネフクキタル登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On a very particular day for auspicious wonders, Matikanefukukitaru gains an abundance of good luck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Believing this to be the grace of the great Shiraoki, she begins preparing for the Twinkle Series.
